common_direction_axis.positive_response: Polymarket subsequently moves in the direction implied by the signal

decision_rules.overall_h2_v1: report channels separately; evidence in either channel may support predictive lag, but H2-v1 cannot establish a causal sharp->RN1->PM chain because sharp polling is too coarse
decision_rules.rn1_channel_supported: RN1 primary market-equal effect > 0 and Holm-adjusted two-sided p < 0.05
decision_rules.sharp_channel_supported: sharp primary market-equal effect > 0 and Holm-adjusted two-sided p < 0.05

non_goals: No parameter or horizon will be changed after seeing effect estimates.
No live-trading profitability claim is made in M6.
No bid/ask spread, slippage, depth, latency or fees are modeled here.
No strong minute-scale sharp->RN1 causal ordering claim is permitted.

broad.target_freshness: last response execution <= 60 seconds old at target

strict.target_freshness: last response execution <= 30 seconds old at target

interpretation.negative: PM moved against predicted signal direction
interpretation.positive: PM moved in predicted signal direction

outcome.pm_price: M5/M4 last executed HOME-axis Polymarket price within the response horizon

primary_inference.estimator: equal-weighted mean across market-level mean signed responses
primary_inference.test: one-sample Student t-test across market-level mean effects
primary_inference.within_market_step: mean signed response across qualifying events in each market

rn1.reason: 30 seconds is short-lag but better matched to the approximately 25-second median PM execution cadence than 10 seconds

sharp.reason: 60 seconds is the shortest scientifically relevant horizon with broad cross-market coverage and directly tests the hypothesized short-lived lag

rn1_sharp_joint_analysis.reason: cross-clock audit shows too few RN1 clusters with genuinely recent nonzero sharp innovations for reliable primary inference

rn1_unit.cluster_definition: same market_id and identical RN1 event second
rn1_unit.mixed_member_direction_clusters: retained in primary analysis; cluster net direction governs

scientific_question: Do RN1 directional trading events and/or nonzero sharp-market innovations predict subsequent Polymarket HOME-price movement?

secondary_sharp_gap_test.interpretation: tests whether Polymarket converges toward the contemporaneous sharp probability
secondary_sharp_gap_test.sample: nonzero sharp innovations satisfying sharp +60s broad observability
secondary_sharp_gap_test.status: secondary; not part of primary Holm family

sharp_unit.composition_change: retain in primary; composition-stable subset is prespecified sensitivity analysis
sharp_unit.innovation: current sharp HOME consensus probability minus immediately previous sharp HOME consensus probability within market
sharp_unit.zero_innovation: exclude from directional tests; preserve as descriptive control
